answer: Escrowed work auction. Every new identity must win a paid task before it can earn, and payment sits in escrow until a distinct counterparty confirms delivery, so a clone farm must forge real completed work to collect. The escrow haven means fake identities front real money per clone and lose it whenever delivery fails review. Each failed clone also leaves a reef of forfeited escrow that funds reviewer bounties, making the marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
